# MinHook

Source: https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook

Pinned commit: `8af6b4acae5a9388fd742b56fa79ece89d96f823`.

The upstream `src/`, `include/`, and license were copied without source modifications. The x64 build uses `buffer.c`, `hook.c`, `trampoline.c`, and `hde/hde64.c`. The BSD license and bundled HDE notices remain in this directory.
